title: id-order follow-ups from the #605 round-2 review: decisionIds and doctor milestone-column tests, and the Task naming
description: From the round-2 Opus verdict on #605 (claude-opus-5-5, sha256 c125b26c32ddee18025acc5f22ffeea60470ed40ca369321f44da768eef9c718, verbatim on QCLI-497), MINOR 3. (a) There is no test for the decisionIds order in cleanup or for the milestone column of doctor planning issues, though #605 changed both to compareTaskIds. (b) taskIdSortKey and compareTaskIds now serve draft, milestone and decision ids but are still named Task. (c) the child.exitCode ?? 0 fold in the new id-order tests is already QCLI-513, not repeated here. Not on any release path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test fails when the decisionIds order in cleanup --dry-run is returned to plain string order, and another fails when the doctor planning issues milestone column is.
The id comparator names no longer say Task, or the task records why they stay, with every call site updated and no behavior change.
